# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b34 — Selected room temperature and live managed-climate card controls

## Room temperatures: respect the sensors explicitly selected in setup

Before this beta the per-room climate plan read only one legacy `climate_rooms[area].temperature_entity` and could report no room temperature even while the user explicitly selected one or several valid sensors for the same area under `room_sources.temperature`. Mold monitoring independently expected a single calibration input.

- The room plan now uses the mean of **explicitly selected, current, correctly typed, native temperature sensors** when there is no individual pinned sensor. Each reading must belong to the exact HA area. Invalid, stale or missing inputs remain unavailable; they never become a fabricated 0°C or false normal reading.
- An explicit pinned temperature source retains priority. If the pin is invalid, unselected or in the wrong room the Manager does not silently replace it with a different sensor.
- Mold indication can use that same verified room sensor selection when its own physical indoor temperature pin has not been configured. An existing dedicated mold pin is not silently replaced or recalibrated. Cold-surface calibration still requires real physical measurements.
- The climate plan exposes the input source and validation status for debugging. Source selection alone **never** authorizes or forces hardware operation.

## Environment-only is not an unavailable HVAC controller

`environment_only_no_hvac` is the room-level monitoring strategy, not an error saying physical devices are absent. Heat/cool planning with no room-wide thermostat stays informational. This code is now described intelligibly in the card, and the independent physical managed controllers appear below.

## Live Lovelace climate controls

Each Manager native climate facade for a room appears with its actual Home Assistant entity name, observed HVAC mode and controller status. Clicking its name opens HA's existing **More Info** entity dialog. The card exposes the same per-device Control Method choices as the exact Manager-created select entity: Existing, Automatic, PID, Manual and Off as supported.

When Manual is selected, the card offers editable temperature and/or humidity targets according to that managed climate entity's **advertised native supported features**, min/max bounds and current setpoint. Writes use standard `select.select_option`, `climate.set_temperature` or `climate.set_humidity` on the exact selected Manager entities, never on an inferred physical source. Unavailable/ambiguous controllers and out-of-range targets do not accept commands.

The old card pause/resume handler also pointed at an obsolete integration alias. It now calls only canonical `environment_manager` actions.

Unsupported selected air-quality sources show their actual entity identity rather than the raw translation token `metric_unknown`.

## Preserved contracts

- Only `environment_manager`; no migration, legacy alias or vendor-specific workaround.
- Native equipment identity, on/off ownership, exact-area boundaries, physical command acknowledgement, configured windows, minimum on/off, hard limits and anti-conflict safety remain unchanged.
- Stable latest remains v0.5.1; beta31-33 repairs included.

Python 3.13/3.14, installed HA 2026.10, JS card tests, HACS/Hassfest, translations and flat prerelease package checks gate publication.
